title: A reflection on AI advances in the past decade and how scaling and time-horizon trends might point to far greater capabilities in the decade ahead (Zhengdong Wang)
summary: Zhengdong Wang: A reflection on AI advances in the past decade and how scaling and time-horizon trends might point to far greater capabilities in the decade ahead — People love to predict the future. Back in June, Peter Thiel recounted a conversation he had with Elon Musk.
